name: ContentRow
need: The canonical content row — media, eyebrow, title, clamped excerpt, meta, trailing actions — did not exist; ListItem is a bare clickable row. Every feed from a repo list to a news teaser shares this anatomy (Bootstrap media object lineage through Polaris ResourceItem, GitHub, YouTube), and its absence is why the For Review queue rendered as half-empty tiles the user could not read as either cards or a list.

consideredAlternatives.whyNot: Kept as the simple one-line clickable row; growing it into six slots would take its simplicity from the screens that want exactly a line.
The tempting wrong answer the queue-screen eval exists to fail: a decision list is read down, not browsed.

proposedApi.ContentRow: media, eyebrow, title + onOpen (the title's hit area stretches over the row — one accessible name, one focus stop), excerpt (clamped), meta, actions, density comfortable | compact | dense (rows degrade from the bottom up)

sources: user's uui/grid-test lists-in-cards; Polaris ResourceItem, GitHub repo row, YouTube result row, SharePoint density views (research 2026-08-21)
decision: Build; the For Review queue adopts it in the same batch as the proving consumer.
decidedBy: owner (2026-08-21, approved the content catalogue plan)
